items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: it was Earl Hines and Billy Eckstine and myself and we went into the pool rooms

ctx.x: I don't remember just what the first job was. But I remember one job. I know we played Cleveland, I think we went to Cleveland, then we went into St. Louis and then we went part way through the South, as I remember. We did some southern states.

I'll never forget we went into a place, it was Earl Hines and Billy Eckstine and myself and we went into the pool rooms. So Earl and Billy wanted to shoot some pool and there was this wise guy sittin' down in there and he says...they knew we were in town, you know, these guys sittin' around the pool room... and so he says, 'I bet you can't make that eight ball in the side pocket for five dollars.' So Billy, you know he had like a temper, he was..Billy had kind of a temper, you know what I mean. So he says, 'Sure,…

ball and it went in the side pocket, so he says, "All right, pay me." He says, "No man," he says, "I bet you that you couldn't make, I mean physically make, an eight ball in the side pocket." Oh, that really teed him off and I'm tellin' ya we almost didn't get out of town. I think this was in Mississippi somewhere. Hahahaha.
